claim: Preregistered draft claim: if a+s and b+s are exact, fl(fl(a+s)-fl(b+s)) is bitwise equal to fl(a-b).
discoveredBy: Z3 4.15.4 bit-blasted IEEE binary32 query (SAT in about 30 s); binary64 queries returned unknown at 120 s
binary64: The same values are exact in binary64 and reproduce the sign difference with CPython floats.
explanation: Value equality holds; only the sign of an exact-zero result differs, because an exact zero difference of equal shifted operands is +0 under RNE while -0 - +0 is -0.
resolution: value-objective-v2 canonicalizes every published float with x + 0.0 (maps -0 to +0 under RNE, identity otherwise), so published loss and gradient are bitwise shift-invariant; intermediate claims are restated as IEEE value equality.
